messages:
maria: Quick sync — Skylark wants a final perf/W + sustained throughput sweep next Tue-Wed. Need owners for: kernel tuning verification, thermal headroom logs, and the marketplace performance blurb. Who can take what?
kevin: I can own kernel verification. will run kernel+driver combo on the 4xA100 nodes we reserved. planning a micro-patch to scheduler.
kevin: plan is: boot config, run perf harness at three sequence lengths, collect KV hit stats and power via ipmi.
sophia: I’ll handle thermal headroom and ambient variation tests. will instrument with the new temp sensors and put telemetry in prometheus job.
rahul: marketplace blurb/notes from infra side — I’ll draft the text and include the SLA/latency p50,p95 numbers and cost estimate per-1M tokens. also coordinate embargo/launch date.
maria: awesome. kevin — can you share the exact perf command you’ll run so sophia can correlate power samples?
kevin: sure — command below (will run inside docker env):
``` 
./bench-run --model skylark-v1 --bs 1,4,8 --seq 128,512,2048 --streams 8 --duration 600 --power-sample /dev/ipmi0 --out results/skylark-kernel-verify.csv
```
kevin: expected columns: seq,bs,streams,tokens_per_sec,watts_avg,kv_hit,lat_p50,lat_p95
sophia: perfect. I’ll align my prom job to ping the node every 5s and export watt and inlet temp. will attach labels node_id and run_id.
bench-bot: automated note: previous dry-run (2026-11-02) had ~6% perf/W regression vs baseline on seq=2048; kernel scheduler patch candidate improved it by ~3% in lab.
maria: good to know — rahul, for the marketplace blurb we should call out the tested config and the quantization level used. also include the fallback model variant we validated for lower-memory hosts.
rahul: yes — draft will include: tested hw (4xA100 40GB), driver/kernel versions, quantization (int8-q4f32), batch sizing, and a short note on expected throughput per-tenant at commit levels.
kevin: question — any embargo/legal constraints from Skylark around publishing numbers?
maria: they gave a 48h pre-announce review window and want final copy + perf artifacts on Friday EOD.
sophia: timeline check: tests Tue-Wed, results Thurs morning for internal review, finalize Friday for partner review. that fits.
kevin: I’ll tag results with run_id skylark-2026-11-09 and push raw csv + kernel diff to the shared folder.
kevin: sample kernel diff header:
``` 
--- a/kernel/sched.c
+++ b/kernel/sched.c
@@ -102,6 +102,9 @@
+ // reduce wakeup penalty for high-throughput streams
+ static inline void adjust_stream_sched(...) { ... }
```
kevin: will include perf traces and flamegraphs as gz.
rahul: I’ll prepare marketplace blurb draft in the shared doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/partners/skylark-bench — will ping when ready.
maria: small ask — sophia, please capture a 30s thermal stabilization period before each run so we can show steady-state watt numbers.
sophia: noted. will add stabilization windows and a short csv of inlet/outlet temps.
maria: thanks all. next checkin here after the first rack finishes Tue AM. :rocket:
